claims.text: The views Usually 2 or more views of each breast at different angles, with the breast compressed between plastic paddles
claims.quote: Mammograms are breast radiographs, which usually include 2 or more views of each breast taken at different angles. The breasts are compressed with plastic paddles to optimize visualization of breast tissue and abnormalities.

claims.text: Tomosynthesis: a 3-D technique of thin slices that reduces the effect of overlapping breast tissue
claims.quote: Tomosynthesis, a 3-dimensional technique, can be used in mammography. In tomosynthesis, an x-ray source moves over an arc of excursion, providing thin, tomographic slices, which are reconstructed into 3-dimensional images. This technique minimizes the effect of overlapping structures in the breast.

claims.text: Screening or diagnostic? Screening: checks for breast cancer in women without symptoms
claims.quote: Screening mammograms are used to check for breast cancer in asymptomatic women

claims.text: Diagnostic: for breast symptoms, palpable masses or abnormal screening results; can add specialized views
claims.quote:
Diagnostic mammograms are used to diagnose breast disorders in women who have (1):
Breast symptoms
Palpable breast masses
Abnormal results on screening mammograms that require further investigation
Diagnostic mammograms can include standard and specialized views.

claims.text: An abnormal screening mammogram is followed by image-guided biopsy
claims.quote: For patients with an abnormal screening mammogram, image-guided biopsy is performed.

claims.text: Breast density Dense breast tissue on screening mammography is linked to about a 2-fold higher breast cancer risk
claims.quote: Dense breast tissue: Dense breast tissue seen on screening mammography is associated with an approximately 2-fold increased risk of breast cancer
